scope: P0 original character, 8-view whole portrait and 3 semantic-component GIF groups
findings: face.skin includes ears while ear.near separately contains the same anatomy
hair.front contains ahoge and gold cross hair clip also generated in the identity GIF
eye.near frame contains two eyes in the 0-degree and 45-degree views
the identity-group clip occupies a different global location from the whole-view clip
the separately generated 90-degree clip is visible even though the far-side clip is occluded in the whole-head 90-degree view
the standalone 1254x1254 RGBA master image has stray edge islands and saturated fringe; cleanup required
GIF files were received with .png suffix despite internal GIF89a signatures

headReconstruction.method: nearest-neighbor whole-canvas normalization then semantic back-to-front alpha composition, upper 75% mask
headReconstruction.metric: approximate silhouette IoU against full-view reference; not a formal VDD quality score

decision.recommendedNext: bind all generated PNGs to the same validated 1024x1024 coordinate system, use mutually exclusive parts and native RGBA edge alpha, reconstruct 0/45/90 endpoints before VDD

storagePolicy: GitHub text audit only; raw images, extracted frames, source hashes and montage remain in private conversation artifact bundle
